name: recordmeeting-extension
description: Chrome extension for recording and transcribing Google Meet meetings

scripts.build:esbuild: npx esbuild src/background/background.ts --outfile=dist/background/background.js --format=esm --platform=browser --bundle && npx esbuild src/content/content.ts --outfile=dist/content/content.js --format=esm --platform=browser --bundle && npx esbuild src/content/googleMeetAdapter.ts --outfile=dist/content/googleMeetAdapter.js --format=esm --platform=browser --bundle && npx esbuild src/pages/Dashboard.tsx --outfile=dist/pages/Dashboard.js --format=esm --platform=browser --bundle && npx esbuild src/pages/MeetingDetails.tsx --outfile=dist/pages/MeetingDetails.js --format=esm --platform=browser --bundle && npx esbuild src/popup/popup.tsx --outfile=dist/popup/popup.js --format=esm --platform=browser --bundle && npx esbuild src/services/database.ts --outfile=dist/services/database.js --format=esm --platform=browser --bundle && npx esbuild src/services/storageService.ts --outfile=dist/services/storageService.js --format=esm --platform=browser --bundle && npx esbuild src/services/transcriptionService.ts --outfile=dist/services/transcriptionService.js --format=esm --platform=browser --bundle && npx esbuild src/services/deepSeekService.ts --outfile=dist/services/deepSeekService.js --format=esm --platform=browser --bundle && npx esbuild src/types/types.ts --outfile=dist/types/types.js --format=esm --platform=browser --bundle && npx esbuild src/utils/constants.ts --outfile=dist/utils/constants.js --format=esm --platform=browser --bundle && npx esbuild src/utils/formatters.ts --outfile=dist/utils/formatters.js --format=esm --platform=browser --bundle
scripts.build: npm run build:tsc && shx rm -rf dist && shx mkdir -p dist/public && shx mkdir -p dist/popup && shx cp -r public dist/public && shx cp manifest.json dist/ && shx cp src/popup/popup.html dist/popup/ && npm run build:esbuild
